Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can lock dates: 

- Goal: run a partner-led technical deep dive that covers (1) marketplace listing flow, (2) integration options for private deployments, and (3) performance/cost tuning for your GSI customers.
- Attendees: SkyReach engineering (you + Marco), Redwood product/solutions (Camila to lead demo), and a brief ops/contract touch with Vivek.
- Ask from SkyReach: confirm a 60–90 minute slot and whether Marco will demo any internal testbed or we should use Redwood test tenant.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 2028-06-14, 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2028-06-15, 14:00–15:30
- Fri 2028-06-16, 09:00–10:30

I’ve attached a short Integration Requirements checklist (skyreach_integration_requirements.pdf) — can you confirm any special network/VPC constraints we need before the demo? Also attaching a lightweight PO template for procurement planning (sr_po_template.xlsx).

If those times don’t work, send a few alternatives and we’ll mirror them. Camille will run the demo and I’ll coordinate follow-ups.

Thanks —
Jonas
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Appreciate the recap and attachments. Marco (copied) will be the technical lead from our side. Quick answers:
- We prefer Redwood to demo from your test tenant so we can focus on the integration points rather than environment setup.
- Network constraints: we have a central VPC with private subnets and strict egress rules; I’ll confirm exact allowlist CIDRs but anticipate at least a short list.

From our calendar, Thu 2028-06-15 14:00–15:30 PST looks best. Marco can do that slot.

A couple of asks for the agenda so we can invite the right folks:
1) Marketplace listing walkthrough (permissions, manifests, metadata)
2) Private deployment onboarding (VPC/KMS, data isolation patterns)
3) Performance tuning — batching/quantization tradeoffs for GSIs
4) Next steps: procurement / marketplace enablement checklist

Will you please send a calendar invite with the agenda and a short pre-demo checklist?
